title: Daily arXiv physics — Friday, 6 November 2026
global_caveat: arXiv has no official trending chart; this is an inferred ranking of notable recent papers, not measured popularity. Citation evidence is limited for papers only days old.

sections.title: Electrically tunable superconducting dimensionality in stripe-ordered monolayer MoTe$_2$
sections.abstract: The authors report that stripe order in monolayer MoTe$_2$ confines superconducting correlations to quasi-1D channels, while electrostatic doping restores phase-coherent 2D superconductivity.
sections.claimed_result: The authors identify a stripe charge-density wave and report quasi-1D superconducting correlations in the undoped state, changing to phase-coherent 2D superconductivity under electrostatic doping.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; Raman spectroscopy, scanning tunnelling microscopy, directional transport, and tunnelling spectroscopy on monolayer 1T′-MoTe$_2$
sections.unique_caveat: The authors note that disorder may suppress transverse phase coherence; their homogeneous model does not reproduce the undoped quasi-1D response, and whether the gate-driven evolution is a crossover or phase transition remains unresolved.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Cross-listed in four condensed-matter subfields; the claimed dimensional tuning is supported by complementary Raman, scanning-tunnelling, transport, and tunnelling-spectroscopy probes.

sections.title: Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment
sections.abstract: The authors generalize the out-of-time-order correlator to monitored circuits, predict measurement-dependent scrambling and decay, and report observing the behavior in simulation and on a trapped-ion quantum computer.
sections.claimed_result: The authors find that local measurements attenuate the OTOC behind a still-causal scrambling front; the H2 trapped-ion data broadly reproduce the predicted unitary and non-unitary behavior.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical, computational, and experimental; transfer-matrix analysis, Monte Carlo, circuit simulation, and Quantinuum H2 hardware (8-qubit hardware runs)
sections.unique_caveat: The hardware sample is small, and the paper says finite-sampling fluctuations and hardware noise cannot yet be cleanly separated in some deviations from theory.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Connects quantum information and condensed matter; combines analytical transfer-matrix results and Monte Carlo with a direct trapped-ion implementation.

sections.title: First broadband search for fixed-polarization dark photon dark matter with GigaBREAD
sections.abstract: Reanalysing GigaBREAD data with a polarization-matched likelihood, the authors report no fixed-polarization dark-photon signal and set kinetic-mixing limits near $10^{-12}$ over 44–52 μeV.
sections.claimed_result: The authors find no signal and set limits on kinetic mixing at roughly $10^{-12}$ for 44–52 μeV (10.7–12.5 GHz), under their fixed-polarization likelihood model.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; analysis of GigaBREAD broadband dish-antenna data using a time-dependent polarization-matched likelihood
sections.unique_caveat: This is a null result, not a detection; the limits depend on the assumed signal and local dark-matter model and on treatment of instrumental baseline structure.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Four-archive cross-listing; first broadband test of the fixed-polarization scenario; reanalysis improves the stated limit by about 20% relative to a naive rescaling of the earlier GigaBREAD limit.

sections.title: Correlations and fluctuations of flow with event shape engineering in Pb-Pb and Xe-Xe collisions at the LHC
sections.abstract: ALICE measures correlations among anisotropic-flow coefficients in Pb–Pb and Xe–Xe collisions and reports how event-shape selection changes the linear and nonlinear components of $v_4$ and flow fluctuations.
sections.claimed_result: The authors observe strong anticorrelation of $v_2$ with $v_3$, positive correlation of $v_2$ with $v_4$, and a nonlinear $v_4$ component coupled to initial-state ellipticity.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; ALICE event-shape-engineering and multiparticle-correlation analysis of Pb–Pb at 5.02 TeV and Xe–Xe at 5.44 TeV
sections.unique_caveat: The authors report relative systematic uncertainties as large as 10% for Pb–Pb $v_4$ and 11% for Xe–Xe $v_4$; event-shape selection can also modify fluctuations and introduce selection bias.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: New collaboration measurement spans two collision systems and energies and reports direct event-shape-dependent flow-component measurements.

sections.title: Commissioning and Performance of the LHCb Upstream Tracker
sections.abstract: The authors report commissioning and performance of the new LHCb silicon-strip Upstream Tracker, an important element of the upgraded tracking system and software trigger.
sections.claimed_result: From early-2025 13.6 TeV proton-proton data, the authors report about 99% efficiency for assigning at least two tracker hits to long tracks and about 96% operational channels.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; LHCb commissioning and tracking-performance analysis using approximately 20 fb$^{-1}$ of collected data
sections.unique_caveat: The layer-efficiency estimate assumes no ghost tracks among three- and four-layer matches and equal average layer efficiency; efficiency also falls at low transverse momentum and in locally inefficient regions.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Detector-performance release based on early Run 3 data, with a CERN-LHCb technical report number and quantitative hit-efficiency results relevant to the upgraded trigger.

sections.title: BeAR: The Bern Atmospheric Retrieval code — A GPU-accelerated framework for low-resolution, high-resolution, and joint retrievals of exoplanet atmospheres
sections.abstract: The authors present a GPU-based joint atmospheric-retrieval framework and demonstrate it on Gemini/IGRINS and JWST/NIRSpec spectra of WASP-77Ab, while finding that abundance-ratio posterior uncertainties are underestimated in injection–recovery tests.
sections.claimed_result: The authors reproduce published WASP-77Ab retrieval quantities within the stated 1–1.5σ comparisons and report million-model-per-minute throughput on a GPU cluster.
sections.evidence_type: computational; GPU forward modelling and retrievals using Gemini South/IGRINS and JWST/NIRSpec observations
sections.unique_caveat: Injection–recovery tests indicate abundance-ratio posterior uncertainties are underestimated by about a factor of two; the demonstrations concern one hot Jupiter.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Cross-links exoplanet science and astronomical methods; combines two spectral resolutions and tests spectra from two observatories.

sections.title: Exact and Near-Exact Inverse Renormalization Group with Constrained Monte Carlo
sections.abstract: The authors prove conditions for exact inverse renormalization at a fixed point and demonstrate constrained-Monte-Carlo inversion on three-dimensional $\phi^4$ theory, reporting no critical slowing down in their test.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report constructing near-equilibrium configurations from $V=16^3$ to $V=128^3$ and a dynamic critical exponent $z=0.03(2)$ in their 3D $\phi^4$ test.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical and computational; constrained Markov-process analysis and Monte Carlo lattice configurations
sections.unique_caveat: The numerical demonstration is for a particular 3D $\phi^4$ setup and optimized transformation; broader universality and finite-size behavior need further tests.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Cross-listed across lattice, statistical, high-energy, and mathematical physics; combines an analytical condition with a concrete large-volume lattice demonstration.

sections.title: Joint analysis of the Macquart relation and the dispersion measure power spectrum: cross-covariance and redshift self-calibration
sections.abstract: The authors derive and simulate the covariance between two fast-radio-burst dispersion-measure observables and forecast tighter baryon-density and host-contribution constraints when combined with weak-lensing information.
sections.claimed_result: The authors find a per-cent-level cross-correlation for individual DMs and forecast 32% tighter physical baryon-density constraints when adding the Macquart relation to the stated joint analysis.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical and computational forecast; halo-model derivation, log-normal forward simulations, and an LSST-like survey forecast
sections.unique_caveat: The improved constraints are forecasts, not observed gains; a 20% error in the mean DM–redshift relation can bias power-spectrum estimates by up to 2σ per band in the authors’ $5×10^5$-FRB scenario.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Combines complementary FRB observables with an LSST-like weak-lensing forecast and validates the covariance calculation with $10^4$ simulated FRBs.

sections.title: Provable circuit-level thresholds for non-abelian topological phases
sections.abstract: The authors construct syndrome-extraction circuits and an on-the-fly decoder for quantum memories in 2D non-chiral topological orders, proving a threshold under a local stochastic circuit-level noise model.
sections.claimed_result: The authors prove a circuit-level threshold for their syndrome-extraction and decoding scheme under local stochastic noise and discuss extensions to logical gates.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical; Turaev–Viro-path-integral-based syndrome circuits and classical decoding algorithm
sections.unique_caveat: The stated guarantee is for a specified local stochastic noise model and 2D non-chiral topological orders; practical hardware performance and gate extensions are not established by the abstract.
sections.evidence_for_ranking: Three-field cross-listing and a concrete error-correction construction with an explicit threshold claim; connects topological field-theory tools to quantum-memory circuits.
